text:
marta: Pushed a small docs PR that expands the sealed-site install checklist and adds a dedicated conn-checker section for Windows/ARM and air-gapped hubs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2578. Main additions: minimal PowerShell conn-check, offline bundle verification steps, HSM PKCS#11 example for sealed networks, and a short note about WPAD causing funky proxying in sealed sites. Looking for quick review from @niles and @oliver.

niles: Thanks — will skim. Two immediate asks: call out SNAT/masquerade implications for kube-proxy in sealed networks, and please use forward-slash paths in the prose with a literal Windows snippet for copy/paste.

marta: Done. I changed prose to forward-slash paths and included a literal PowerShell block. Also added a short bullet under HSM troubleshooting about verifying NTP (<5s skew) and re-importing chain if PKCS11 ops fail.

oliver: Quick nit: the offline bundle verify example should show both bundle + manifest checks. Suggest adding the exact command people can run: `sha256sum redwood-offline.tar.gz redwood-offline-manifest.json`.

qa-bot: Linkcheck: detected 1 moved anchor in PR #2578 -> /install/private#network-kicks. Suggested replacement: /install/private/networking-checklist. Label: doc:link-fix.

marta: Good catch — fixed anchor and updated link. Also added the `sha256sum` example and a short GPG verification note for externally mirrored bundles.

niles: Can you paste the conn-checker snippets here so I can sanity-check the flags?

marta: Sure — snippets from the PR: 

```powershell
# conn-checker minimal (Windows ARM64 copy/paste)
.\conn-checker.exe --host 10.0.2.4 --port 8443 --timeout 8 --use-sni --ca C:\certs\redwood-ca.pem
```

```bash
# conn-checker (Linux/mac)
./conn-checker --host 10.0.2.4 --port 8443 --timeout 8 --use-sni --ca /etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem
```

```ini
# Example: kms-pkcs11.conf for sealed site (illustrative)
provider = /usr/lib/pkcs11/hsm-provider.so
slot = 0
pin = ${HSM_PIN}
# note: use env var or secret store in real deployments, never commit real PINs
```

marta: Also added a short troubleshooting example for Windows cert import: `certutil -addstore -f \"ROOT\" C:\\certs\\redwood-ca.pem`. Marked it as literal so people can copy/paste.

oliver: LGTM. A couple suggestions: 1) mention that some appliances renumber PKCS11 slots after firmware updates (add a troubleshooting bullet to re-check slot numbering and token labels); 2) call out WPAD disable line for sealed networks — we've seen customers hit that.

marta: Added both: WPAD note and slot renumbering bullet. Also added a tiny SDK snippet showing minimal retry + `verify` pointing to private CA for users hitting intermittent TLS errors: 

```python
# minimal private SDK retry example
import requests
from time import sleep
for attempt in range(3):
    r = requests.post('https://10.0.5.10:8443/v1/generate', json=payload, verify='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem')
    if r.ok:
        break
    sleep(2 ** attempt)
```

niles: Looks good. One small wording tweak: in the HSM section, prefer \"service wrapper\" instead of \"systemd\" when describing Windows guidance.

marta: Updated wording. Also pushed a tiny extra commit to escape backslashes in the PowerShell example for the docs build.

docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed, linkcheck fixed previous anchor, spellcheck flagged 'masquerade' but accepted.

oliver: Approving from infra side. @niles if you're happy, merge on green and please add a short changelog note.

niles: Approving. Will merge once CI finishes. Follow-up: file a docs ticket to expand the conn-checker section into a dedicated troubleshooting page next sprint. :memo:

marta: Thanks all. Will add changelog entry after merge. :shipit: (thread covers PR coordination, link fixes, tiny example snippets for Windows/ARM, offline verification, and HSM troubleshooting)
